info.about: Metal Walker, known as Bakusou Senki Metal Walker GB: Kotetsu no Yuujou in Japan, is a role-playing video game for the Game Boy Color, developed and published by Capcom. Many critics likened the game to the Pokémon series, but praised the game's unique qualities.
info.trivia: Critics likened it to Pokémon but singled out its science-fiction spin on the monster-collecting formula, with robots built from a metal called Core.
info.why: Capcom brought it to North America in February 2001, over a year after Japan and four months before the Game Boy Advance launched, which cut its shelf life short.
